defects.root_cause: The collector used capture_manifest.json as a canonical payload and CAPTURE_MANIFEST.json as the transport identity manifest. On case-insensitive Android-visible storage these names collide, overwriting the data payload manifest.
defects.repair: Future replacement captures use REPLACEMENT_CAPTURE_PAYLOAD.json plus CAPTURE_MANIFEST.json, and generic manifest construction rejects case-insensitive canonical-payload collisions.

defects.root_cause: Each historical request window deduplicated internally, but the collector appended windows without a final global timestamp canonicalization. Broker responses may overlap window boundaries.
defects.repair: Generic frontier M5 capture now canonicalizes all final rows by timestamp across windows, preserves only row-identical repeats, and fails closed on conflicts; CSV inspection also requires strictly increasing timestamps.
